newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Treasury says no T-note tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Treasury says no T-note tender.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will not be holding a Treasury note tender this week, the second week in a row that it has not offered notes for tender, the Reserve Bank of Australia said on Tuesday.
The last tender was held on May 28 when the Treasury offered a total of A$800 million of notes, comprising A$600 million of five-week notes and A$200 million of 13-week notes.
There are A$767 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending June 12.
